{{nihongo|'''Oosakayamaguchi Shrine'''|大坂山口神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine''' (おおさかやまぐちじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} located in {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ōsaka}} (Ōsaka), {{ill|Kashiba, Nara|ar|كاشيبا (نارا)|azb|کاشیبا، نارا|ca|Kashiba|ce|Касиба|ceb|Kashiba-shi|de|Kashiba|eo|Kaŝiba|es|Kashiba (Nara)|fa|کاشیبا، نارا|fi|Kashiba|fr|Kashiba|gl|Kashiba|hy|Կաշիբա|id|Kashiba, Nara|it|Kashiba|ja|香芝市|ko|가시바시|mzn|کاشیبا، نارا|nl|Kashiba|pl|Kashiba|pt|Kashiba|ro|Kashiba|ru|Касиба|simple|Kashiba, Nara|sv|Kashiba|tg|Кашиба|th|คาชิบะ|tl|Kashiba, Nara|tr|Kashiba|tt|Касиба|uk|Касіба|ur|کاشیبا، نارا|vi|Kashiba, Nara|war|Kashiba, Nara|zh|香芝市|zh_classical|香芝市|zh_min_nan|Kasiba-chhī|zh_yue|香芝|qid=Q696643}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}.

=== Overview ===
The shrine is enshrined in the northeastern vicinity of {{ill|Nijō Station (Nara)|eo|Stacio Nijō (Nara)|ja|二上駅|ko|니조역 (나라현)|ur|نیجو اسٹیشن (نارا)|zh|二上站|qid=Q7034597}} on the {{ill|Osaka Line|Q1052545|qid=Q1052545}}.

Together with {{ill|Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine (Anamushi)|ja|大坂山口神社 (香芝市穴虫)|qid=Q135069035|lt=Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine}} in the Anamushi district, it is identified as the shrine that enshrined the Ōsaka deity mentioned in a dream oracle recorded in the 9th year of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|Q333530|qid=Q333530}} in the {{ill|Kojiki|Q813031|qid=Q813031}} and {{ill|Nihon Shoki|Q813935|qid=Q813935}}: “With eight red shields and eight red halberds, enshrine the god of Sumisaka (Sumisaka-no-kami); with eight black shields and eight black halberds, enshrine the god of Ōsaka (Ōsaka-no-kami).” (Incidentally, the god of Sumisaka is identified with {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Sumisaka Shrine}} in {{ill|Uda, Nara|ar|يودا (نارا)|azb|اودا، نارا|ca|Uda (Nara)|ce|Уда (гӀала)|ceb|Uda Shi|de|Uda (Nara)|es|Uda (Nara)|et|Uda (Jaapan)|fa|اودا، نارا|fi|Uda (Nara)|fr|Uda (Nara)|gl|Uda, Nara|hy|Ուդա|id|Uda, Nara|it|Uda (Nara)|ja|宇陀市|ko|우다시|min|Uda, Nara|mzn|اودا، نارا|nl|Uda (stad)|pl|Uda (miasto)|ro|Uda, Nara|ru|Уда (город)|sv|Uda, Nara|tl|Uda, Nara|tr|Uda, Nara|tt|Уда (шәһәр)|uk|Уда (Нара)|ur|ادا، نارا|vi|Uda, Nara|war|Uda, Nara|zh|宇陀市|zh_classical|宇陀市|zh_min_nan|Uda-chhī|zh_yue|宇陀|qid=Q863747}}.)<ref name="city-muse">[https://www.city.kashiba.lg.jp/uploaded/attachment/1655.pdf Ōsaka and Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine] - Kashiba City Futakami Mountain Museum</ref><ref name="pref-db">[https://www.pref.nara.jp/miryoku/ikasu-nara/bunkashigen/main00217.html Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine Main Hall, Sacred Statues and Treasure Items (Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine Main Hall, Sacred Statues and Treasure Items of Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine)] - Nara Prefecture Historical and Cultural Resources Database</ref>.

In addition, together with the Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine in the Anamushi district, it is considered a candidate shrine (ronsha) for Ōsaka Yamaguchi Shrine, one of the shrines listed in the {{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Yamato Province|abstract|Q11433427|ja|大和国の式内社一覧|qid=Q11433427|lt=List of Shikinaisha in Yamato Province}}<ref name="city-muse"/><ref name="pref-db"/>.
